description: DNS propagation check — Compare a DNS record across three independent public resolvers (Cloudflare, Google, AdGuard) and get a PROPAGATED / INCONSISTENT verdict with each resolver answer and TTL. For agents verifying a DNS change after a deploy, domain move or email setup. Price: $0.004 USDC (Base, via x402).

type.description: optional: A (default), AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, NS, SOA, CAA
